==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I attained lucidity via sleep paralysis. My goal was to discover the true name of the Death Demon. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Death Demon is the demonic true form of the Death Staff. The Death Staff resembles a wooden staff that radiates with purple energy. The staff is currently off-world on the Golem Planet.) I asked the Village King to think back to when they were possessed to recall the demon's name. (The Village King resembles a giant, wooden, elf man who wears a green robe with a white fur collar.) The demon's name is Interminus, which is the key to controlling him if he regains his demon form. (If the Death Witch ever dies, the Death Staff will become Interminus. The Death Witch resembles a woman with pale skin, straight black hair, red eyes, long tattered black robes, and a belt made of skulls.) (After I woke up I Googled 'Interminus' and discovered that the Latin word 'Interminis' means boundless or endless. Maybe the Death Demon's real name is this Latin word that I had never heard of? Maybe his English name would be 'The Endless'.)
